clm_sister_villages_founded_93384580.statement_en: Nathor (Nathuwas) was one of twelve villages founded by Nathu Dhatarwal.

clm_acquisition_period_b223afcb.statement_hi: नौ गांव 1981 से 1986 के बीच महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज हेतु खाली करवाए गए, जिनमें नाथौर भी था।
clm_acquisition_period_b223afcb.statement_en: Nine of the twelve villages, including Nathor, were vacated between 1981 and 1986 for the Mahajan Field Firing Range.

clm_resettlement_sites_5453f673.statement_en: Displaced families were resettled in Sansardesar, Karnisar, Krishnanagar, Takhatpura, Samartha, Varani and Nathusar Vas, among other canal-irrigated areas.

clm_villages_retained_outside_range_5546.statement_en: Three of the twelve villages -- Sulera, Bhikhnera and Meghana -- remained outside the firing range and were not vacated.
